title: Use frequency capping - Google Ads Help

facts.fact: Frequency capping limits the number of times ads appear to the same person, and it can be used in Display campaigns and Video campaigns.
facts.quote: Frequency capping allows you to limit the number of times ads appear to the same person. You can use frequency capping in Display campaigns and Video campaigns.

facts.fact: For Display campaigns, third-party cookies are used by default, and first-party cookies are used to approximate impressions if third-party cookies are not available.
facts.quote: Third-party cookies are used by default, but if those aren’t available, then first-party cookies are used to approximate impressions.

facts.fact: In Display campaigns, frequency capping can only be set from the "Frequency management" section of campaign settings, and frequency capping settings cannot be adjusted when a new campaign is created.
facts.quote: You can only use frequency capping from the "Frequency management" section in your campaign settings. You can’t adjust frequency capping settings when you create a new campaign.

facts.fact: In Display campaigns, a frequency cap can only be set after the campaign is created.
facts.quote: You can only set a frequency cap in a Display campaign after you create the campaign.

facts.fact: For Display campaigns, only viewable impressions count toward frequency caps.
facts.quote: For Display campaigns, only impressions that were viewable count toward frequency caps.

facts.fact: For Display campaigns, Google Ads can optimize how often ads show to users (recommended) or the advertiser can choose its own frequency cap settings.
facts.quote: You can choose to let Google Ads optimize how often your ads show (recommended) or choose your own settings for the frequency cap.

facts.fact: Frequency caps for Video campaigns can only be set at the campaign level.
facts.quote: Frequency caps for Video campaigns can only be set on the campaign level.

facts.fact: A Video campaign frequency cap can be based on impressions, views, or both impressions and views, for selected time intervals.
facts.quote: you set a limit on your videos in a campaign for selected time intervals based on:

facts.fact: If videos in a Video campaign are used in other Video campaigns, impressions and views from those other campaigns count toward the frequency cap of that campaign.
facts.quote: If the videos in a campaign are used in other Video campaigns, both those other impressions and views count towards the frequency cap of that campaign.

facts.fact: When a user reaches a Video campaign's frequency cap, Google stops showing that campaign to the user, and this applies only to in-stream and bumper ads in the auction.
facts.quote: When a user reaches the frequency cap, Google stops showing this campaign to the user. This only applies to in-stream and bumper ads in the auction.

facts.fact: Video campaign frequency cap values must be whole numbers, for example 4 and not 4.5.
facts.quote: The value must be a whole number (such as 4, not 4.5).

facts.fact: The time interval for a frequency cap can be set per day, per week, or per month.
facts.quote: Select a time interval (per day, week, or month).

facts.fact: New Video campaigns offer a "Cap impression frequency" option and a "Cap view frequency" option under Frequency capping in Additional settings.
facts.quote: Cap view frequency: Limit how many times ads in this campaign can get a view or interaction from the same user.
